LanguageData.Plant_WaterLily.label: water lily
LanguageData.Plant_WaterLily.description: A cultivated aquatic flower with broad floating leaves and a pale blossom. It is grown for beauty rather than for food.
LanguageData.Plant_Glowreed.label: Glowreed
LanguageData.Plant_Glowreed.description: An alien aquatic reed that stores solar energy during the day and releases a faint bioluminescent glow after dark. Its light becomes stronger as the plant grows and fades as its stored energy is depleted. It is decorative and cannot be harvested.
